title: The week on TCGplayer
headline: The 5 biggest moves on the board's 7-day list, prices Oct 27 to Nov 3.
dek: TCGplayer's market price for Pikachu ex - 107 (30th Celebration) fell 49.7% to $77.83 and Mewtwo - 51/108 (Cracked Ice Holo) rose 39.1% to $37.10 between Oct 27 and Nov 3. None of the 5 has a checked sale behind the move: unconfirmed means Mission Control checked no sale in the window, not that anything is wrong.
why_now: Mission Control writes this File every morning from the nightly TCGplayer pull, so the board has a fresh File on the mornings no hand-written one is up (Tue, Thu and Sat are its days).
risk: A market price is TCGplayer's average of recent completed sales of the same card, condition and printing, so one sale can move a thin card. The list's rule keeps out the moves nothing backs, not every thin one. This is not a read on whether these prices are high or low.
what_to_watch: Whether these moves hold on tomorrow's pull. A card drops off the list by moving less than 5% in a week, more than 60% with no checked sale, without its lowest listing moving the same way, or below $20. The next hand-written File day is Thursday, Nov 5.
source: TCGplayer market prices via tcgcsv.com, the board's 7-day list (prices Oct 27 to Nov 3, 2026, published Nov 4)

foot: Market price: TCGplayer's average of recent completed sales of the same card, condition and printing (help.tcgplayer.com). Change: the median of the market price over the 3 days ending Oct 27 against the same over the 3 days ending Nov 3; the start-of-week price is that first median, the end-of-week price the latest reading. The list: up to 10 Pokémon cards worth $20 or more that moved 5% or more in a week; with no checked sales, a move shows only if it's 60% or less, the lowest listing moved the same way by at least a quarter as much, the price changed in the last 2 days, and the card trades (its price changed on 3 or more of the last 14 days). A card not on it may have moved less, more, or in a way the rule leaves out. Unconfirmed: no sale checked by Mission Control's Sale Integrity Layer in that window. Written by Mission Control from the Nov 4, 2026 pull; a hand-written File takes its place when one goes up (Tue, Thu and Sat are its days). Not advice.
